title: Warm Nutty Mediterranean Tripe Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring tripe, double-rise bread, and Mediterranean spices, perfect for a hangover cure. This dish is also ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly.

ingredients.name: tripe
ingredients.notes: beef or pork tripe, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the tripe, cumin, paprika, and chicken broth to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Add the torn bread to the pot and continue to simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and chopped parsley.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
